name: tenstorrent
title_zh: 跳过网页控制台，直接调 Tenstorrent 全家
tagline_zh: 聊天、画图、视频、TTS、STT 一个 Skill 全包。不用开浏览器、不用记 API 文档。
tagline_en: Skip the web UI. Trigger chat, image, video, TTS, STT from your terminal with a single skill. No browser, no API.
desc_en: Use Tenstorrent console.tenstorrent.com models across chat, image, video, TTS, and STT. Triggers: tenstorrent, 텐스토렌트, Torendissi, 토렌디시, Wan2.2, T2V, text-to-video, image jobs, SDXL, tt-sd3.5, tt-z-image-turbo, DeepSeek-R1, Qwen3, tts-1, whisper-large-v3.
why_zh: 把 console.tenstorrent.com 的模型全收进一个触发词，连 Wan2.2。
why_en: Packs the entire console.tenstorrent.com model lineup behind one trigger word—Wan2.2, SDXL, DeepSeek-R1 included. Feels like.
limit_zh: 需要 Tenstorrent 账号和有效 API 密钥；只覆盖 console.tenstorrent.com 上架模。
limit_en: Requires Tenstorrent account & API key. Covers only console.tenstorrent.com models, not local/third-party. Remote quota limits apply.
title_en: One command to reach all Tenstorrent console models: chat.
